content.name: Danielle Ortiz
content.title: Administrative Assistant
content.summary: Administrative assistant with eight years of front-office and executive support experience across dental, title and engineering firms. Keeps calendars, travel and vendor accounts running for a three-partner leadership team, and cut the office supply budget by $11,400 a year after renegotiating contracts.

experience.title: Front Desk Receptionist
bullets: Greeted and checked in roughly 60 patients a day, verifying insurance eligibility before each appointment to avoid billing surprises.
Rebuilt the recall reminder process in Dentrix, which brought the six-month hygiene no-show rate down from 18% to 11%.
Balanced the daily cash drawer and card batch with zero unexplained variances across 20 months.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
bullets: Prepared closing packets for about 45 residential transactions a month, cross-checking legal descriptions against the title commitment.
Set up a shared Outlook calendar for four escrow officers so closings stopped being double-booked during the 2021 refinancing rush.
Scanned and indexed 9,000 archived files into the document management system, freeing a rented storage unit costing $310 a month.
Trained two new receptionists on wire-fraud callback procedures and the phone system within their first week.

experience.title: Executive Administrative Assistant
bullets: Manage calendars, expense reports and travel for three managing partners, booking more than 70 trips a year within the travel policy.
Renegotiated office supply, coffee and printer lease agreements, saving $11,400 annually without changing vendors' service levels.
Coordinate quarterly board meetings end to end: agendas, minutes, catering for 25 and follow-up action tracking in Smartsheet.
Built a SharePoint onboarding checklist used for 14 new hires, so laptops, badges and accounts are ready on day one.

achievements.title: Partner's Choice Award 2024
achievements.detail: Recognized by the partners for organizing a 120-guest client open house on a $9,000 budget.

achievements.title: Paperless office project
achievements.detail: Led the archive digitization that retired the firm's off-site storage unit.
